Metrics.ttlPolicy: 200 ms base TTL plus deterministic 0-24 ms jitter

Evidence: OutboundCallCounter observed 20 origin loads for 20 simultaneous cache callers.
Fixed mode uses ConcurrentDictionary<string, Lazy<Task<CacheEntry>>> execution-and-publication coalescing.
Limitations: Single-flight state is process-local. A multi-node cache needs a distributed lock or a stale-while-revalidate strategy to prevent cross-node stampedes.
